tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Which model to call for a need, on the providers the user has accounts with: the provider's own model id, its price, capabilities and the reason. Give `providers` and a `task` or a `purpose`; add `needs`, `budget`, `origin` and other constraints to narrow it. `shape` asks for a team or an escalation

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Reads a description of the work (a prompt, tags, attachment types and sizes) into a need, then resolves it as `resolve` does. Use `resolve` when you can state the task or purpose yourself; use this when you only have the user's words. Counts as more than one call.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The catalog's models with each provider's offering, price, capabilities and quality scores, filtered by task, providers and needs. Returns 20 models unless `limit` says otherwise; page with `offset`. Counts as one call.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model by id (`vendor/model`, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5`): every provider's offering with its price history, capabilities, limits and dates, and the model's quality scores. Counts as one call.

tools.name: list_purposes
tools.description: The purpose presets `resolve` accepts: named jobs such as reading receipts or a coding agent, each with the task, needs and budget it stands for. Free.

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Every name the other tools accept: tasks, capabilities and their levels, providers, origin groups, budgets and team strategies. Free.
